name: Fruit Million Respin

features.name: Expanding wild respins
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand and trigger respins.

review:
Fruit Million Respin keeps the bright green look and 100 lines of the original Fruit Million but changes how wilds behave. When a wild lands on reel 2, 3 or 4, it expands to cover the reel, pays, and triggers a respin.

Respins can stack random multipliers across the main reels, giving this version more punch than the original. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 3,000x maximum, and the RTP is 97%. There's no complex bonus, just fast classic play with expanding-wild respins. A good upgrade if you liked Fruit Million but wanted a little more action.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
